members.name: A
members.instructions: A customer sent this message to a digital bank's support chat. Which issue is the customer asking about? Pick the most specific matching issue.

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: A card payment on the account that the customer does not recognise or did not make
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: A cash/ATM withdrawal on the account that the customer did not make, or a withdrawal shown in the app for cash they never received, e.g. 'I see non-received cash in my app' (not a withdrawal they did make that is pending or not yet reflected in the balance)
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: A direct debit the customer does not recognise or did not set up, or wants refunded
criteria.unknown_money_in_account: Money or a transaction appeared in the account that the customer did not put there or does not know the source of
criteria.compromised_card: Customer thinks their card details or PIN were stolen, compromised, skimmed, or used by someone else
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: Reporting a card as lost, missing or stolen, or asking what to do about it
criteria.found_card_reactivate: Customer found a card they had reported lost and wants to reactivate it or add it back to the app
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: Phone with the banking app lost, stolen or left behind (e.g. at a hotel); protecting the account or using the app without the phone
criteria.request_refund: Customer wants a refund for a purchase, wants to cancel an order or purchase from a merchant, or asks how refunds work
criteria.refund_not_showing: A refund or payment back from a merchant that the customer expected but cannot find in the account or statement (e.g. 'how come I can't find my payment?')
criteria.charged_twice: The same transaction was charged twice or several times / duplicate charges, even if the payment was declined
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment that was cancelled, terminated, reverted or returned to the account after being made, or payments to the card that were cancelled
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: The ATM dispensed less cash than requested or than was debited, gave no cash, or would not give the amount the customer wanted; the customer says they haven't received their cash yet
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: An unexplained small extra charge or fee on the statement (e.g. an extra or pending £1 charge for nothing they bought, 'what is this extra fee on my statement?'), not a fee on a transaction the customer made and knows about (that is a card payment or transfer fee)
criteria.card_arrival: Card ordered but has not arrived yet; tracking card delivery
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long card delivery takes, delivery options
criteria.card_linking: Linking a card to the app/account, adding an existing card
criteria.card_not_working: Card is not working / stopped working in general
criteria.card_about_to_expire: Card expiring soon; getting a replacement for an expiring card
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card is accepted, which merchants/ATMs it works at
criteria.change_pin: The card PIN: changing it, finding or receiving it, or general questions about the PIN
criteria.pin_blocked: PIN blocked, rejected or no longer giving access to the card (e.g. after too many wrong tries); unblocking the PIN
criteria.declined_card_payment: A card payment that was declined
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: An ATM cash withdrawal that was declined
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, or a virtual card not working
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Getting a disposable (single-use) virtual card, its limits, or it not working
criteria.physical_card: Ordering or getting a physical card, including what a card costs to get
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which card brand or type the customer can get or choose (Visa or Mastercard, choosing which card to use)
criteria.apple_google_pay: Using Apple Pay or Google Pay, including topping up with them and which currencies or cards work with them
criteria.atm_support: Which ATMs can be used, ATM availability
criteria.pending_card_payment: A card payment showing as pending, or a payment (not a transfer) taking a long time to go through (not a payment the customer cannot find at all)
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal showing as pending or in progress (even if the ATM did not work), not yet shown on the account, or the balance not yet reflecting a recent ATM withdrawal
criteria.transfer_not_received: Money sent by transfer but the recipient has not received it
criteria.transfer_timing: How long transfers take to arrive
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer that was declined or not allowed, including when the customer calls their declined attempts transfers
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: Cannot add or pay a beneficiary/payee
criteria.cancel_transfer: Cancelling a transfer already made, or sent money to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: Receiving money or salary into the account, including getting paid or receiving salary in another currency
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to transfer money into the account / deposit
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: Balance not updated after a bank transfer in
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: Balance not updated after a cheque or cash deposit
criteria.top_up_how: How to top up / add money to the account in general, which top-up methods are or are not accepted, where the top-up option is, or letting other people top up the account
criteria.top_up_by_card: Topping up or adding money to the account with a debit or credit card, or using a credit card to transfer money in
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer: Topping up the account by bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Topping up or depositing with cash or a cheque, where to deposit cash
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Whether a particular kind or brand of card is supported, e.g. 'can I use my American Express to add money?', 'is my credit card supported for top-ups?', or which card brands and currencies the bank supports (not Apple Pay / Google Pay, and not Visa-vs-Mastercard questions)
criteria.top_up_pending_or_failed: A top-up that is pending, failed, or was reverted
criteria.top_up_limits: Top-up limits, or general daily or maximum amount limits on the card or account (e.g. what is the daily limit on my card)
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up / card top-up verification code, or why top-ups need verifying
criteria.card_payment_fee: A fee charged on a card payment the customer made, e.g. unexpected extra fees when paying or buying abroad or in a foreign currency
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: A fee charged for withdrawing cash / ATM fees
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee charged on a transfer or for receiving money, including whether the full amount of a transfer (e.g. SEPA) will arrive or fees will be taken off
criteria.top_up_fee: A fee for topping up by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: General questions about what exchange rate is used or how it is set, with no complaint about a specific transaction
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: A wrong or unexpected exchange rate was applied to a card payment or cash withdrawal, so the customer got or paid a different amount than expected (including asking how the rate is worked out because they got less money than expected)
criteria.currency_support: Which currencies (fiat or crypto) the bank supports for holding and exchanging
criteria.verify_identity: Verifying identity, why identity verification is needed, or verification failing
criteria.source_of_funds: The source of funds: proving or finding out where the customer's funds come from or who is giving them money (without claiming the money is unauthorised)
criteria.edit_personal_details: Changing name, address or other personal details
criteria.account_security_general: General questions about how the bank keeps customers' money and accounts safe or secure, with no specific incident
criteria.crypto_purchase: Purchasing cryptocurrency in the app, or a crypto purchase not going through (not topping up with crypto)
criteria.country_support: Which countries the service is available in or whether it can be used all over the world, including whether people living in another country (e.g. the US) can sign up or get a card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: Forgotten or not working app passcode, resetting the passcode / login

members.name: C
members.instructions: You are triaging a customer's message to a digital bank. Which of these issues best describes what the customer needs help with?

criteria.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a card purchase they didn't make or don't recognise
criteria.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The customer sees an ATM withdrawal they didn't make, or the app lists cash withdrawn that they never got, e.g. non-received cash showing in the app (not their own withdrawal that hasn't shown up yet)
criteria.direct_debit_not_recognised: There is a direct debit the customer never set up or doesn't recognise, or they want a direct debit refunded
criteria.unknown_money_in_account: Funds or a transaction showed up in the account that the customer didn't add and can't explain
criteria.compromised_card: The customer fears someone else has their card details or PIN, or that the card was skimmed or misused
criteria.lost_or_stolen_card: The customer is reporting that their card is lost, missing or stolen, or asks what to do now
criteria.found_card_reactivate: The customer has found a card previously reported lost and wants to use it again or re-add it to the app
criteria.lost_or_stolen_phone: The customer's phone (with the bank app) was lost, stolen or left somewhere (like a hotel) and they want to secure the account or still use the app
criteria.request_refund: The customer asks for their money back for something they bought, wants to cancel an order or purchase with a merchant, or asks how refunds work
criteria.refund_not_showing: The customer expected a refund or a payment back from a merchant but can't see or find it in the account
criteria.charged_twice: The customer was charged two or more times for the same thing, even when the payment shows as declined
criteria.reverted_card_payment: A card payment was cancelled, terminated, reversed or sent back to the account after it was made, and the customer asks why
criteria.wrong_amount_of_cash: The cash machine gave out less money than asked for or than was taken from the account, gave nothing, or the customer says they still haven't received their cash
criteria.extra_charge_on_statement: A mysterious small extra charge or fee appears on the statement (like an extra or pending £1 for nothing bought); not a fee on a transaction the customer knowingly made
criteria.activate_card: The customer wants to activate their new card
criteria.card_arrival: The customer's ordered card hasn't arrived; tracking it
criteria.card_delivery_estimate: How long it takes to deliver a card, delivery options
criteria.card_linking: The customer wants to link or add a card to the app or account
criteria.card_not_working: The customer's card has stopped working, without more detail
criteria.card_about_to_expire: The card is about to expire or has expired; replacing it
criteria.card_acceptance: Where the card can be used: which shops, merchants or ATMs accept it
criteria.card_swallowed: A cash machine kept or swallowed the card
criteria.change_pin: Anything about the card PIN: changing it, where to find or get it, explaining it
criteria.pin_blocked: The PIN is blocked or rejected and won't let the customer use the card (e.g. after wrong attempts); how to unblock it
criteria.declined_card_payment: A purchase with the card was declined or refused
criteria.declined_cash_withdrawal: The ATM refused or declined a cash withdrawal
criteria.virtual_card: Getting a virtual card, or the virtual card isn't working
criteria.disposable_virtual_card: Single-use (disposable) virtual cards: getting one, their limits, or one not working
criteria.physical_card: Ordering or receiving a physical (plastic) card, including what it costs to get one
criteria.spare_card: Getting an extra or additional card
criteria.visa_or_mastercard: Which kind or brand of card the customer can get or pick (Visa vs Mastercard, choosing a card to use)
criteria.apple_google_pay: Paying or topping up with Apple Pay or Google Pay (including what currencies or cards they accept); Apple/Google Pay not working
criteria.atm_support: Which cash machines the customer can use; ATM availability
criteria.pending_card_payment: A payment made with the card is still pending, or a payment (not a transfer) is taking long to go through (not one the customer can't find)
criteria.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal is still pending or in progress (even when the machine failed), hasn't appeared, or the balance doesn't reflect a recent ATM withdrawal yet
criteria.transfer_not_received: The customer sent a transfer but the recipient says it hasn't arrived
criteria.transfer_timing: How long a transfer takes to arrive
criteria.pending_transfer: A transfer is stuck as pending
criteria.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or blocked, including when the customer calls their declined attempts transfers
criteria.beneficiary_not_allowed: The customer can't add or pay a payee/beneficiary
criteria.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel a transfer they made, or sent money to the wrong account
criteria.receiving_money: Getting money or a salary paid into the account, including being paid in a different currency
criteria.transfer_into_account: How to move or deposit money into the account
criteria.balance_not_updated_transfer: The balance hasn't updated after a bank transfer came in
criteria.balance_not_updated_deposit: The balance hasn't updated after depositing a cheque or cash
criteria.top_up_how: General questions on adding money to the account, which ways of topping up are or are not allowed, finding the top-up option, or other people topping up the account
criteria.top_up_by_card: Adding money with a debit or credit card, or moving money in with a credit card
criteria.top_up_by_bank_transfer: Adding money to the account with a bank transfer
criteria.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Adding money with cash or a cheque; where cash can be deposited
criteria.supported_cards_and_currencies: Whether a given card type or brand works with the bank, such as using an American Express or a credit card to top up, or which card brands and currencies it supports (questions about Apple/Google Pay or about Visa vs Mastercard belong elsewhere)
criteria.top_up_pending_or_failed: A top-up is pending, failed, or was reversed
criteria.top_up_limits: Limits on top-ups, or general daily or maximum amount limits on the card or account
criteria.automatic_top_up: Setting up or using auto top-up
criteria.verify_top_up: Verifying a top-up, e.g. the verification code for a card top-up
criteria.card_payment_fee: The customer was charged a fee on a card payment they made, e.g. unexpected extra fees on purchases while abroad or in another currency
criteria.cash_withdrawal_fee: Fees for taking out cash / ATM fees
criteria.transfer_fee: A fee on a transfer or on receiving money, or whether the whole amount of a transfer (such as SEPA) will be received without fees deducted
criteria.top_up_fee: A fee for adding money by card or bank transfer
criteria.exchange_rate: How the bank sets its exchange rates or which rate it uses, asked in general rather than about a transaction that went wrong
criteria.wrong_exchange_rate: The exchange rate applied to a card payment or withdrawal was wrong, or the customer got less money than expected and asks how the rate was worked out
criteria.exchange_charge: Charges for exchanging money between currencies
criteria.currency_support: Which currencies (fiat or crypto) the bank supports for holding and exchanging
criteria.verify_identity: Identity checks: how to verify, why it is required, or verification not working
criteria.source_of_funds: Where the customer's money comes from: proving the source of funds, or asking where their funds come from or who is giving them money
criteria.edit_personal_details: Updating name, address or other personal information
criteria.account_security_general: General questions about how the bank keeps money and accounts secure, not about a specific incident
criteria.crypto_purchase: Purchasing cryptocurrency through the app, or a crypto purchase that fails (not crypto top-ups)
criteria.country_support: Which countries the bank operates in or accepts customers from, or whether it works all over the world, e.g. whether someone in America can sign up for a card
criteria.passcode_forgotten: The customer forgot their app passcode or can't log in
